Messages.Author: Andrew Daley
Messages.Body:
I am not 100% sure how the Soul Gem of Etrius is played. It has had
many changes since I began to use it and dearly would love
clarification.

Can the Soul Gem be stolen as a strike or an action?

Can the Soul Gem be destroyed as a strike or an action?

Can the Soul Gem be moved between a Methuselah's minions?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Andrew Daley wrote:
> I am not 100% sure how the Soul Gem of Etrius is played. It has had
> many changes since I began to use it and dearly would love
> clarification.

Soul Gem of Etrius
Unique equipment.
If the vampire with this equipment is burned, draw the top vampire from
your crypt. If that vampire is younger, put the Soul Gem on him or her
and move him or her to your ready region with blood from the blood bank
equal to his or her capacity; otherwise, move that vampire to your
uncontrolled region (and burn the Soul Gem). If bearer is diablerized,
the diablerizing vampire cannot take the Soul Gem.

> Can the Soul Gem be stolen as a strike or an action?

Not inherently. But any strike or action which can steal equipment can
steal that equipment, yes.

> Can the Soul Gem be destroyed as a strike or an action?

Not inherently, but as above, yes.

> Can the Soul Gem be moved between a Methuselah's minions?

Any minion can take an action to take a friendly minion's equipment.
[6.1.3]
Other effects can also be used to move equipment, as allowed by
card text.
